table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	TuitionFee=1,
	Grade = (SELECT Grade.Name FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=C.GradeCode),
	NumericGrade = (SELECT Grade.NumericalFactor FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=C.GradeCode),
	ClassCode = SC.ClassCode,
	ClassName = C.Name,
	StudentCode = SC.StudentCode,
	RegNo = S.RegNo,
	StudentName = S.Name,
	RollNo = SC.RollNo,
	ServiceCode = C.ServiceForTuitionFee,
	ServiceName = (SELECT SV.Name FROM Service SV WHERE SV.ServiceCode = C.ServiceForTuitionFee),
	Fee = CASE WHEN S.FeePaidUptill > GETDATE() THEN 0.00 ELSE C.Fee END, 
	FlatDiscount = CASE WHEN S.FeePaidUptill > GETDATE() THEN 0.00 ELSE S.FlatDisc END, 
	DiscPerc = CASE WHEN S.FeePaidUptill > GETDATE() THEN 0.00 ELSE S.DiscPerc END, 
	S.FeePaidUptill,
	duedate = :ad_duedate,
	SELECTED='Y'
FROM
	Student S, StudentClass SC, Class C
WHERE 
	C.Active = 'Y' AND
	C.ClassCode IN (:ai_classcode) AND
	SC.PromotionRowID IS NULL AND
	SC.GraduationRowID IS NULL AND
	C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
	SC.StudentCode = S.StudentCode
UNION
SELECT 
	TuitionFee=0,
	Grade = (SELECT Grade.Name FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=C.GradeCode),
	NumericGrade = (SELECT Grade.NumericalFactor FROM Grade WHERE Grade.GradeCode=C.GradeCode),
	ClassCode = SC.ClassCode,
	ClassName = C.Name,
	StudentCode = SC.StudentCode,
	RegNo = S.RegNo,
	StudentName = S.Name,
	RollNo = SC.RollNo,
	ServiceCode = SVC.ServiceCode,
	ServiceName = SVC.Name,
	Fee = SVC.Price, 
	FlatDiscount = 0.00, 
	DiscPerc = 0.00, 
	FeePaidUptill=NULL,
	duedate = :ad_duedate,
	SELECTED='Y'
FROM
	Student S, StudentClass SC, Class C,
	(SELECT SV.Servicecode, SV.Name, SV.Price
	FROM Service SV 
	WHERE SV.ServiceCode IN (:ai_servicecode)) SVC
WHERE 
	C.Active = 'Y' AND
	C.ClassCode IN (:ai_classcode) AND
	SC.PromotionRowID IS NULL AND
	SC.GraduationRowID IS NULL AND
	C.ClassCode = SC.ClassCode AND
	SC.StudentCode = S.StudentCode
table.sort: numericgrade A, classname A, rollno A, studentname A, tuitionfee D, servicename A

objects.name: compute_1
objects.expression: sum(if( selected = 'N', 0, ( fee - flatdiscount) * (1 - discperc * 0.01)) for all)
